## 1. POLICY STATEMENT

TechVenture Solutions is committed to maintaining a workplace environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. This policy establishes our zero-tolerance approach toward any form of discriminatory conduct and outlines the comprehensive procedures for addressing violations. All employees, contractors, vendors, clients, and visitors are expected to adhere to these standards without exception.

## 1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE

This policy establishes TechVenture Solutions' commitment to maintaining the highest standards of ethical conduct and provides employees, contractors, and stakeholders with secure channels to report concerns regarding potential violations of law, company policy, or ethical standards. This procedure applies to all TechVenture Solutions personnel, including full-time employees, part-time staff, contractors, consultants, and temporary workers across all global locations.

### 1.2 Scope
This policy applies to all employees, contractors, and authorized agents of TechVenture Solutions who participate in procurement activities, including but not limited to: purchasing goods and services, vendor selection and evaluation, contract negotiation and execution, and payment processing. All expenditures exceeding $500 must comply with the procedures outlined herein.

This policy will be reviewed annually by the Finance Committee and updated as necessary to reflect changing business requirements, regulatory compliance needs, and industry best practices.

## 7. Policy Violations and Enforcement

Non-compliance with these protocols may result in performance improvement plans, additional training requirements, or disciplinary action as outlined in the Employee Handbook Section 4.2. For questions regarding policy interpretation, contact the Operations Help Desk at operations@techventure.com.
